messages.全スキルが減算コイン(コイン威力がマイナス)の打撃アタッカー。スキルを使うたびに: A Blunt attacker whose skills all have negative Coin Power. Skills lower his SP, making Tails more likely and preserving high Power. His main attack is S3 Self-destructive Purge, with 30 Base Power and 3 Coins.
messages.減算コイン: 基本威力が高く、コイン威力がマイナス(S1「追い立てられた審判」7: **Minus Coins**: High Base Power with negative Coin Power (S1 Coerced Judgement 7/8 and −2, S2 Amoral Enactment 12/16 and −3/−4, S3 30 and −12). Power drops the more Heads land, so he is stronger the lower his SP and the more likely Tails is (lower SP making Tails more likely is a general game rule).
messages.精神力の自己消耗: 使用時に精神力がS1で7、S2で10、S3で15減る。守備「: **Self-draining SP**: On use, he loses 7 SP with S1, 10 with S2, and 15 with S3. The Defense skill Enough… restores 5–10 SP at Combat Start.
messages.バトルパッシブ「狂炎」(憤怒×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): マッチ勝利・敵討伐時: **Combat passive — Mad Flame (2 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: SP recovered on Clash Win and on defeating enemies is reduced by 50%. If 5 or more N Corp. Fanatics, including himself, are alive, N Corp. Fanatics deal +10% damage.
messages.S3「自滅的浄化」: 狂信があればダメージ量+15%。Ⅱコインの的中で、与えたダ: **S3 — Self-destructive Purge**: +15% damage with Fanatic. On Coin Ⅱ hit, shifts the Stagger Threshold by 50% of the damage dealt. Coin Ⅲ inflicts 5/7 Burn if the target has at least 5 Bleed, and grants 1 Blunt Power Up next turn on defeating an enemy.
messages.狂信と火傷: S1はⅡコインの裏面的中時に次のターンの狂信1を得る。狂信があると: **Fanatic and Burn**: S1 grants 1 Fanatic next turn on Coin Ⅱ Tails Hit. With Fanatic, S2 deals +5/10% damage and S3 +15%. S1 and S2 also inflict Burn.
messages.まず憤怒×2を確保して「狂炎」を発動させる。憤怒スキルはS3だけなので、味方の憤: First, secure 2 Wrath to activate Mad Flame. His only Wrath skill is S3, so it is more efficient to have allies' Wrath skills supply the resources. Attack every turn to keep his SP on the negative side. At −45 SP, he panics or undergoes E.G.O Corrosion the next turn, so slip in his Defense skill or a Clash Win just before that to bring SP back. He is advantaged in battles that start at 0 SP (story stages and Refraction Railway), but pairs poorly with effects that heal the ally with the lowest SP.
